newsitem.title: UK: BG dep chairman Rogerson set to quit - report.
newsitem.headline: BG dep chairman Rogerson set to quit - report.

text.p: The Times newspaper said on Thursday speculation is growing that Philip Rogerson, deputy chairman of BG Plc, is set to leave the gas supplier.
The Times, quoting sources close to the company, said Rogerson was not expected to complete the full term of his contract, which expires at the end of 1999.
BG said Rogerson would continue as deputy chairman.
"It is not imminent that Philip Rogerson is going," the Times quoted the company as saying.

The newspaper noted that Rogerson led BG's campaign against price curbs proposed by the gas industry's regulator Ofgas. This week, the Monopolies and Mergers Commission ruled BG had to cut charges to gas suppliers.
